name: mediaflow
description: A beautifully considered, secure direct-media downloader.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.check: npm run check -w client && npm run check -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server
